# Your Authorship Skill

> You built it. Your name on it. Keeps you the sole author of your code when you build with AI agents: scans your local repos, your GitHub repos and your Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex and Gemini CLI settings for AI co-author trailers, generated-with footers and credit lines, fixes each one only on your OK, and installs a commit-msg hook so new ones are refused. Local only; history is never rewritten.

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add maumoya/your-authorship-skill` then `/plugin install your-authorship-skill@your-authorship-skill`
- Any agent: `npx skills add maumoya/your-authorship-skill@v0.2.0`
- GitHub Action: `uses: maumoya/your-authorship-skill@v0.2.0` fails a pull request whose new commits or files give an AI tool author credit

## Files

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/maumoya/your-authorship-skill/blob/main/skills/your-authorship-skill/SKILL.md): the skill
- [authorship.py](https://github.com/maumoya/your-authorship-skill/blob/main/skills/your-authorship-skill/scripts/authorship.py): scanner and fixer
- [commit-msg](https://github.com/maumoya/your-authorship-skill/blob/main/skills/your-authorship-skill/scripts/commit-msg): the hook
- [action.yml](https://github.com/maumoya/your-authorship-skill/blob/main/action.yml): the GitHub Action (Marketplace)
- [README.md](https://github.com/maumoya/your-authorship-skill/blob/main/README.md): what it does and how to install it
